body.title: Project the four structured body records through ArtifactReviewView
body.summary: Append functionalDefinition, erDefinition, uxDefinition and companions to ArtifactReviewView in src/workflow/artifact-content.ts (currently six members at :45-52) and populate them inside the existing handleArtifactContent from the body it already parses. Absent stays absent — no null, no empty-object default, no backfill, no validation beyond shape. No new IPC method: the existing 'workflow.artifactContent' registration at src/daemon/index.ts:698-700 is untouched. This is the Epic's only daemon-side change, and it needs a daemon rebuild to take effect.
acceptanceChecks: handleArtifactContent projects all four records verbatim when the body carries them
an absent body field projects as an ABSENT view field — not null, not an empty object — so `=== undefined` is the single absence test
a DEF body (functionalDefinition only, never companions) projects exactly what it has and nothing more
a PLAN body's functionalDefinition projects too — the field is not gated on artifact kind
the six pre-existing members keep their names, types and meanings and the existing artifact-content tests pass unchanged
the daemon handler map gains no entry: 'workflow.artifactContent' is still the only read path
a structured record whose shape is invalid still travels through rather than failing the read
